name: California court filings by county: civil, criminal, family, juvenile, probate and appeals, fiscal years 2023–24 and 2024–25
description: How many cases were filed in each of California's 58 superior courts (one per county) and statewide, by case type, from the Judicial Council of California's Court Statistics Reports: unlimited civil (motor-vehicle injury, other injury and wrongful death, other civil), limited civil, unlawful detainer, small claims, felonies and misdemeanors, family law, juvenile, probate, mental health and appeals. One record per county and case type, with the prior year beside it. In every table the 58 counties add up exactly to the report's own statewide row, and the totals inside each row add up too. Counts only: no lawyer or firm is listed or ranked.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). California court filings by county: civil, criminal, family, juvenile, probate and appeals, fiscal years 2023–24 and 2024–25 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963026

distribution.name: ca-courts.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: ca-courts.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: ca-courts-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in ca-courts-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to ca-courts.csv on id.

recordSet.name: ca-courts
recordSet.description: The records of California court filings by county: civil, criminal, family, juvenile, probate and appeals, fiscal years 2023–24 and 2024–25, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: county

field.name: countyName
field.description: County name

field.name: areaType
field.description: us, state or cbsa

field.name: group

field.name: table

field.name: column

field.name: measure
field.description: What the estimate measures

field.name: measureLabel
field.description: The case type, as the report names it

field.name: fy

field.name: value
field.description: The machine value (see unit)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: priorFy

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls

field.name: confidence
